en: Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a broad, quiet avenue lined with multi‑story townhouses and small trees. A church with an onion-shaped tower is visible in the distance at the end of the street. On the left, a woman in old-fashioned dress stands by a fence; on the right are bourgeois villas with ornate façades and a small pavilion or gazebo in a garden. The printed captions at the top read the locality and the street name in German.
